Definition
[Commensurability] \group commensurability Source: thurston:page-0153

Discrete groups $\Gamma _1,\Gamma _2\leq \operatorname {Isom}(H^n)$ are commensurable if, after conjugating $\Gamma _1$, their intersection has finite index in both. Hyperbolic manifolds are commensurable if they possess homeomorphic finite-sheeted covers.
